labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Requests a new SpeedColumn API, which is new behaviour

items.body:
Feature requests need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there if you want this considered.

Rich already has a way to get a custom speed column: subclass [`ProgressColumn`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) and render `task.finished_speed or task.speed` with your own unit. `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` shows speed only while `total` is unknown. Related earlier reports: #3835 and #1964.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
